A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the optical gain of GaAsBi quantum well lasers can be enhanced by the introduction of a GaBi layer at the quantum well/barrier interface.
the optical gain of GaAsBi/GAs quantum well lasers is comparable with that of InGaAs/GaAs quantum wells and that GaAsBi quantum wells are a promising material system for laser diodes.

the GaAsBi/GaNAs material system is a promising candidate for the development of high-power lasers operating at room temperature.

the optical gain in GaAs<sub>x</sub>Bi1-x/GaAs quantum wells can be enhanced by increasing the Bi composition, which leads to the increase of the radiative recombination rate and decrease of the non-radiative recombination rate.
